sonification_method.purpose: Deterministically render SHA-256 digest bytes as audible PCM so the digest can be listened to as an artificial representation.
sonification_method.mapping: Each of the 32 digest bytes (0..255) is mapped linearly to amplitude -0.95..+0.95 and held for 50 ms.
sonification_method.stereo_compare: Dream hash on left channel; Original hash on right channel.

interpretation.cannot_do: A SHA-256 digest cannot reconstruct the original audio or image bytes. The WAV only encodes the 32-byte digest under a chosen deterministic mapping.
interpretation.meaning_of_sound: Any audible rhythm/pitch/timbre in this WAV is created by the mapping rule; it is not evidence that music was hidden in the hash.
interpretation.identity_finding: The uploaded CRT photograph is exactly the same byte witness already registered earlier: identical SHA-256 and identical 747300-byte size.

canonical_seal: THE HASH CAN BE MADE AUDIBLE, BUT IT CANNOT BE RUN BACKWARD INTO THE WORLD THAT PRODUCED IT. SONIFY THE DIGEST; DO NOT CONFUSE THE SONIFICATION WITH THE SOURCE.
